title: Foreign Acquisitions and Takeovers Amendment (Strategic Assets) Bill 2020
short_title: Foreign Acquisitions and Takeovers Amendment (Strategic Assets) Bill 2020

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would stop foreign investors from buying more than a 10% stake in Australian assets considered strategically important to the economy or defence.
A new body called the Foreign Ownership Assessment Board would decide which assets are of strategic importance, with its membership set by a Senate majority.
A 45% stake could be allowed if both houses of Parliament approve it by a two-thirds majority vote.
changes: Creates a new Foreign Ownership Assessment Board to classify strategic assets.
Bans foreign entities from acquiring more than 10% of strategic assets unless Parliament approves a higher threshold.
Allows appeals of Board decisions to a Tribunal, with restrictions on legal representation.
summary.affected: Foreign persons and entities seeking to invest in Australian land, water, or other assets of strategic economic or defensive importance.
